children.text: Greeting & Facilities
children.cn: 问候与校园设施介绍

children.text: Dear Editor,
children.cn: 亲爱的编辑：
children.notes: 书信开头称呼
children.statement: 本句为信件给出的开头称呼。
children.explanation: 题干已给出，不计入总词数。

children.text: Now I'm a student at Sunshine Middle School. I think it is the most beautiful school.
children.cn: 现在我是阳光中学的一名学生。我认为它是最美丽的学校。
children.notes: the most beautiful = 最美丽的（最高级）
children.statement: 本句为题干中预先给出的引入语句。
children.explanation: 题干开头已给出，按规则不计入总词数。
children.keywords: student, Sunshine Middle School, most beautiful

children.text: My school is very big and beautiful, with lots of green trees.
children.cn: 我的学校又大又漂亮，有许多绿树。
children.notes: with = 带有，具有（介词短语作状语）
children.statement: “with lots of green trees” 补充描述了校园环境。
children.explanation: with 介词短语生动呈现绿树成荫的环境。

children.text: We have a modern classroom building, and all the classrooms are clean and bright.
children.cn: 我们有一幢现代化的教学楼，所有的教室都既干净又明亮。
children.notes: classroom building = 教学楼；clean and bright = 干净明亮的
children.statement: 本句涵盖了提示表格中的教学楼环境信息。
children.explanation: 准确对应表格中“一幢教学楼，教室干净、明亮”的要点。

children.text: There is a quiet library across from the dining hall.
children.cn: 在食堂对面有一座安静的图书馆。
children.notes: across from = 在……对面；dining hall = 食堂
children.statement: “across from” 表示方位关系。
children.explanation: across from 表示在对面，符合表格要点。
children.keywords: quiet library, across from, dining hall

children.text: I enjoy reading interesting books there in my spare time.
children.cn: 在空闲时间，我喜欢在那里读有趣的书籍。
children.notes: enjoy doing sth. = 喜欢做某事；in one's spare time = 在某人空闲时间
children.statement: “enjoy reading” 考查 enjoy 后接动名词的用法。
children.explanation: enjoy 后面固定接动词-ing 形式。

children.text: Subject & Club Activity
children.cn: 最喜爱的学科与社团活动

children.text: My favourite subject is science because it is interesting and practical.
children.cn: 我最喜欢的学科是科学，因为它既有趣又实用。
children.notes: favourite subject = 最喜爱的学科；because 引导原因状语从句
children.statement: “because” 说明了喜欢科学学科的具体原因。
children.explanation: 满足提示表格中“你最喜欢的学科及原因”要求。

children.text: So I join the science club and do experiments in the lab after school.
children.cn: 所以放学后我加入了科学社团，并在实验室里做实验。
children.notes: join = 加入；do experiments = 做实验；in the lab = 在实验室里
children.statement: “So” 表示因果承接关系。
children.explanation: 体现了课后积极参与学科拓展活动。

children.text: I can also make many good friends there.
children.cn: 我在那里也能交到很多好朋友。
children.notes: make friends = 交朋友；also = 也
children.statement: “make friends” 意为结交朋友。
children.explanation: 丰富了社团活动的收获与体验。

children.text: Feelings & Sign-off
children.cn: 个人感受与书信结尾

children.text: I love my school deeply because my school life is colorful and meaningful.
children.cn: 我深深地爱着我的学校，因为我的校园生活丰富多彩且充满意义。
children.notes: school life = 校园生活；colorful and meaningful = 多彩且有意义的
children.statement: 本句全面总结了对学校的热爱感受。
children.explanation: 呼应表格中“你的感受”一栏要求。

children.text: What about yours?
children.cn: 你的学校怎么样呢？
children.notes: What about = ……怎么样（征询对方意见）
children.statement: 向读者/编辑提问互动，增强书信交际性。
children.explanation: What about yours 引出下文交流互动。

children.text: All the best, Li Hua
children.cn: 祝好，李华
children.notes: 书信结尾问候与署名
children.statement: 本句为信件给出的结尾署名。
children.explanation: 题干已给出，不计入总词数。

children.text: Greeting & Facilities
children.cn: 问候与校园设施介绍

children.text: Dear Editor,
children.cn: 亲爱的编辑：
children.notes: 书信开头称呼
children.statement: 本句为信件给出的开头称呼。
children.explanation: 题干已给出，两篇范文保持完全一致。

children.text: Now I'm a student at Sunshine Middle School. I think it is the most beautiful school.
children.cn: 现在我是阳光中学的一名学生。我认为它是最美丽的学校。
children.notes: the most beautiful = 最美丽的（最高级）
children.statement: 本句为题干中预先给出的引入语句。
children.explanation: 题干开头已给出，两篇范文保持完全一致。
children.keywords: student, Sunshine Middle School, most beautiful

children.text: Covering a large area, our picturesque campus is surrounded by tall green trees and sweet-smelling flowers.
children.cn: 我们的校园占地面积广阔、景色如画，被高大翠绿的树木和芳香四溢的花朵所环绕。
children.notes: picturesque = 景色如画的；be surrounded by = 被……所环绕
children.statement: “Covering a large area” 为分词短语作伴随状语。
children.explanation: 现在分词短语作状语提升了句式高级感。
children.keywords: picturesque campus, surrounded by, tall trees, flowers

children.text: In the center stands a grand classroom building, where every room is equipped with modern facilities and filled with natural light.
children.cn: 在中央矗立着一幢宏伟的教学楼，那里的每间教室都配备了现代化设施并洒满了自然光。
children.notes: In the center stands... 倒装句；where 引导非限制性定语从句
children.statement: “where” 引导定语从句修饰 classroom building。
children.explanation: 定语从句详尽描述了教学楼内部的明亮与现代化。
children.keywords: classroom building, modern facilities, natural light

children.text: Directly across from the dining hall lies our spacious library, offering a quiet sanctuary for avid readers.
children.cn: 宽敞的图书馆正对着食堂，为热心的读者们提供了一个宁静的避风港。
children.notes: spacious = 宽敞的；offering... 现在分词短语作结果/伴随状语
children.statement: “lies our spacious library” 为完全倒装结构。
children.explanation: 介词短语置于句首引起完全倒装，使方位交代更具画面感。
children.keywords: spacious library, across from dining hall, sanctuary

children.text: Subject & Club Activity
children.cn: 最喜爱的学科与社团活动

children.text: Among all the subjects, science fascinates me the most because it encourages us to explore the mysteries of nature.
children.cn: 在所有学科中，科学最令我着迷，因为它激励我们去探索大自然的奥秘。
children.notes: fascinate = 使着迷；mysteries of nature = 自然奥秘
children.statement: “fascinates me the most” 比 simple like 表达更具感染力。
children.explanation: 使用高级动词 fascinate 增强表现力。
children.keywords: science fascinates me, explore mysteries of nature

children.text: Consequently, I actively participate in the after-school science club to conduct hands-on experiments in the advanced laboratory.
children.cn: 因此，我积极参加课后科学社团，在先进的实验室里进行动手实验操作。
children.notes: Consequently = 因此；conduct hands-on experiments = 进行动手实践实验
children.statement: “Consequently” 是高级连接副词，表示结果。
children.explanation: 连接词使得逻辑推导更加紧密。

children.text: Not only do I gain practical scientific knowledge, but I also build strong friendships with like-minded peers.
children.cn: 我不仅获得了实用的科学知识，而且还与志同道合的同龄人建立了深厚的友谊。
children.notes: Not only... but also... 部分倒装句型；like-minded peers = 志同道合的同龄人
children.statement: “Not only do I...” 为 Not only 置于句首引起的倒装句。
children.explanation: 倒装句结构使得句型多变且富有层次。
children.keywords: Not only, gain knowledge, build friendships, peers

children.text: Feelings & Sign-off
children.cn: 个人感受与书信结尾

children.text: In a word, studying in such an inspiring environment makes my middle school life truly vibrant and fulfilling.
children.cn: 总而言之，在这样一个充满启发性的环境中学习，让我初中生活格外充满活力与充实感。
children.notes: In a word = 总而言之；vibrant and fulfilling = 充满活力且充实的
children.statement: “In a word” 用作总结过渡词。
children.explanation: 在文末进行有力的总结与情感升华。
children.keywords: In a word, inspiring environment, vibrant, fulfilling

children.text: I would be thrilled to hear about your wonderful school as well!
children.cn: 如果也能听到关于你精彩学校的介绍，我将感到非常高兴！
children.notes: be thrilled to do sth. = 非常高兴做某事；as well = 也
children.statement: 委婉得体的书信互动句式。
children.explanation: 增强与收信人的亲和力与交流感。
children.keywords: thrilled to hear, wonderful school, as well

children.text: All the best, Li Hua
children.cn: 祝好，李华
children.notes: 书信结尾问候与署名
children.statement: 本句为信件给出的结尾署名。
children.explanation: 题干已给出，两篇范文保持完全一致。
